targetCondition.marketVerification: /de-de/ official route; page title ends with (DE); German product prices in EUR. Visible initial cookie panel was dismissed using reject/continue without consent.

networkDiscovery.notes: Chrome DevTools pageId 9 recorded actual public watchgrid requests during UI load-more clicks. A same-origin browser fetch reused the observed endpoint. No cookies, auth headers, tokens or personal data saved.

primaryCollectionPath.type: official structured endpoint observed in browser network
primaryCollectionPath.pagination: UI clicks generated cumulative numberOfResults requests 432, 576, 720, 864, 1008, 1152, 1296, 1440, 1584, 1728 and 1872, all firstResult=0; final response totalCount=1465. Same-origin request with firstResult=1465, numberOfResults=2000 returned HTTP 200, zero results, totalCount 1465.

renderedCrossCheck.view: Modellansicht, group=0, no restrictive filters; clicked Mehr ansehen until absent.
renderedCrossCheck.officialResultsLabelAfterFullEnumeration: 1400 Ergebnisse (65 fewer than 1,465 distinct rendered cards and API total).

listingStatusBasis.reason: Six independently selected DE product pages spanning multiple collections, including the lowest and highest list prices, each displayed a public EUR price and only “Kontaktieren Sie einen offiziellen Rolex Fachhändler” / “Kontaktieren Sie einen Fachhändler” linking to the DE official store locator; no online order/cart/checkout CTA appeared. The six separate price APIs matched the listing. The common DE detail page purchase path supports this status for the full visible price list.

tax.source: Official price API notice in six sampled DE product pages; top-level history metadata unchanged.

errors: The unrelated Coveo analytics search request failed DNS resolution; official Rolex catalog/watchgrid and product price requests succeeded.
